Maria Gomez: Quick sync — need to slot calypso-28b onboarding into next sprint. Primary ask: who can own perf + quant experiments? can we get a preliminary prioritization score by EOD?
Arun Patel: I can pick up perf runs (batching + KV cache). I'll run FP16 baseline + 8-bit quant flow. Estimate ~8h run + 2h infra tweaks.
Li Chen: I'll run evals on the benchmark suite (conv/qa/code/hallucination checks). Adding a sheet: https://tiny.redwood/board-calypso
Priya Shah: Suggest a lightweight scoring rubric for triage: Quality 40, Latency 30, Cost 30. Quick formula: score = 0.4*quality_pct + 0.3*(1 - latency_norm) + 0.3*cost_saving_norm. I'll populate the sheet.
Sam Brooks: FYI calypso tends to degrade on >2k contexts in our tests; we should include long-context regressions in the quality bucket.
perf-bot: perf-run completed: baseline FP16 on A100x2 — p50=54ms p95=210ms throughput=430 tok/s
Arun Patel: Re-running with 8-bit quant (int8-like) — preliminary: p50=38ms p95=160ms, throughput=610 tok/s, but rouge/qa F1 drops ~0.6 absolute on dev set.
Li Chen: Eval pass 1 (dev bench): winrate vs current prod model=67% on coding tasks, +0.8 BLEU on summarization, hallucination rate +1.2% (flag)
Priya Shah: Rough numbers plugged: quality_pct=67, latency_norm ~ (1 - (p50_norm)) -> will normalize later. I'll compute proper normalized values and post final score in sheet.
Maria Gomez: For prioritization decision: we can accept up to ~0.5 absolute quality drop if cost savings >30% and hallucination delta <= +1%. Otherwise push to lower priority.
Arun Patel: Will try KV-cache and prefix caching — aiming to reduce long-context latency and hallucination surface. Also collect mem/peak for quant runs.
Li Chen: I'll run hallucination targeted evals (fact-check suite) and provide examples to triage. Expect results by EOD.
Priya Shah: Action items: Arun (perf + kv runs), Li (evals + examples), Priya (score + sheet), Maria (coordinate canary plan). Meeting to decide slot: Wed 11:00am. :calendar:
Sam Brooks: ack
Maria Gomez: thanks — if anyone hits blocking infra errors ping eng-infra and drop logs here. :thumbsup:
